schema.name: app_analyses
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE app_analyses (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	app_name VARCHAR, 
	package_name VARCHAR, 
	developer VARCHAR, 
	category VARCHAR, 
	version_name VARCHAR, 
	apk_size VARCHAR, 
	target_sdk INTEGER, 
	apk_hash VARCHAR, 
	analyzed_at VARCHAR, 
	description TEXT, 
	icon_url VARCHAR, 
	play_store_rating FLOAT, 
	installs VARCHAR, 
	target_age VARCHAR, 
	risk_score INTEGER, 
	risk_grade VARCHAR, 
	risk_level VARCHAR, 
	risk_dimensions_json TEXT, 
	encryption_protocol VARCHAR, 
	authentication_method VARCHAR, 
	data_storage_type VARCHAR, 
	has_2fa BOOLEAN, 
	compliance_standards VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: app_permissions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE app_permissions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	app_id INTEGER, 
	name VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	justified BOOLEAN, 
	necessity_score INTEGER, 
	educational_justification VARCHAR, 
	sdk_attribution VARCHAR, 
	risk_category VARCHAR, 
	privacy_risk_level VARCHAR, 
	is_actually_used BOOLEAN, 
	alternative_permission TEXT, 
	explanation TEXT, 
	child_risk_multiplier FLOAT, 
	base_risk_weight FLOAT, 
	adjusted_risk_weight FLOAT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES app_analyses (id)
)

schema.name: app_reviews
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE app_reviews (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL,

	matched_evidence_ids TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES app_analyses (id)
)
